'''Andrzej Jerzy Buras''' (<small>Polish pronunciation</small>: {{IPAc-pl|'|a|n|d|rz|e|j|-|'|j|e|rz|y|'|b|u|r|a|s}}; born 26 October 1946 in [[Warsaw, Poland]]) is a Polish-born Danish [[theoretical physicist]], professor emeritus at the [[Technical University of Munich]] (TUM).

==Scientific career==
He received his master's degree in theoretical physics at the [[Warsaw University]] in 1971, and immigrated to Denmark in the same year. One year later, he received his PhD at the [[Niels Bohr Institute]] in Copenhagen. He then worked as a post-doctoral fellow at the Niels Bohr Institute until 1975.

After a fellowship in the [[CERN]] theory group from 1975 to 1977, he was first a visitor and then a staff member in the [[Fermilab]] theory group from 1977 till 1982. He then became staff member of the [[Max Planck Institute for Physics]] in Munich (1982–1988). In 1988, he was appointed full professor in the Physics Department of the TUM.<ref name="Smoluchowski-Warburg Medal"/> After his retirement in 2012, he moved to the [[TUM Institute for Advanced Study]] where he is leading the focus group 'Fundamental Physics'.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tum-ias.de/focus-groups/alumni-focus-groups/alumni/andrzej-jerzy-buras.html|title=IAS – Alumni Focus Groups|date=29 January 2016|access-date=6 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161010210957/http://www.tum-ias.de/focus-groups/alumni-focus-groups/alumni/andrzej-jerzy-buras.html|archive-date=10 October 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Buras is known for his early work on strong-interaction effects ([[Quantum chromodynamics|QCD]]) in deep-inelastic electron-proton and neutrino-proton scattering (1977–1980), which led to the commonly used [[MS-bar scheme]] for QCD calculations. But his most important contributions (1983-now) are in the field of [[weak interaction|weak decays]] of mesons; these include high order calculations of QCD effects in most important decays, the phenomenology of [[CP violation]] and of [[Flavour (particle physics)#Quarks|quark flavour physics]] in the [[Standard Model]] and in several [[New Physics]] models.<ref name="Akademie Aktuell">{{ cite web|title=Akademie Aktuell|url=http://www.badw.de/de/publikationen/akademieAktuell/2010/32/00_aa2010_01_gesamt.pdf}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 2024: [[Sakurai Prize|J. J. Sakurai Prize for Theoretical Particle Physics]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?last_nm=Buras&first_nm=Andrzej&year=2024|title=2024 J. J. Sakurai Prize for Theoretical Particle Physics Recipient}}</ref>
* 2020: [[Max Planck Medal]]
* 2012: TUM Emeritus of Excellence
* 2010: [[European Research Council]] Advanced Grant (2011–2016)<ref>{{cite web |title=Towards the Construction of the Fundamental Theory of Flavour |url=https://erc.europa.eu/projects-and-results/erc-funded-projects/project/flavour |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160609201849/https://erc.europa.eu/projects-and-results/erc-funded-projects/project/flavour |archive-date=2016-06-09 |website=erc.europa.eu}}</ref>
* 2010: [[Erwin Schrödinger]] Visiting Professorship, [[University of Vienna]]
* 2008–2011: [[Carl von Linde]] Senior Fellowship at the TUM Institute for Advanced Study<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tum-ias.de/people/fellows/alumni/carl-von-linde-senior-fellows.html|title=IAS – Carl von Linde Senior Fellows|date=5 November 2015|access-date=6 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161010211237/http://www.tum-ias.de/people/fellows/alumni/carl-von-linde-senior-fellows.html|archive-date=10 October 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2007: Smoluchowski-Warburg Medal of the German and Polish Physical Societies<ref name="Smoluchowski-Warburg Medal">{{cite web|title=DPG – Preisträgerinnen und Preisträger 2007|url=https://www.dpg-physik.de/preise/preistraeger2007.html#Marian-Smoluchowski-Emil-Warburg-Preis|access-date=6 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160329203513/http://dpg-physik.de/preise/preistraeger2007.html#Marian-Smoluchowski-Emil-Warburg-Preis|archive-date=29 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2004: Distinguished Lecturer of the Alberta University
* Foreign member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (Warsaw, Poland)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.english.pan.pl/index.php/members/foreign-members/225-foreign-members-division-iii |title=Foreign Members – Division III |author=Administrator |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160610112445/http://www.english.pan.pl/index.php/members/foreign-members/225-foreign-members-division-iii |archive-date=10 June 2016 }}</ref>
* Foreign member of the [[Polish Academy of Arts and Sciences]] (Cracow, Poland)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://pau.krakow.pl/index.php/en/struktura/wydzialy-i-komisje/wydzial-iii-matematyczno-fizyczno-chemiczny|title=Polska Akademia Umiejętności – Wydział III Matematyczno-Fizyczno-Chemiczny|access-date=6 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304162457/http://pau.krakow.pl/index.php/en/struktura/wydzialy-i-komisje/wydzial-iii-matematyczno-fizyczno-chemiczny|archive-date=4 March 2016|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
